title: Unit Event — Choices for the Future — Episode3 An Unexpected Problem

meta.Event Outline: Emu continues studying management with the Morinomiya Revue. While leading fulfilling days full of new connections, she learns that a threat is coming to bear on Morinomiya's Kikyogumi troupe.

rows.Line: The next day
Morinomiya Revue - Corridor

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: Thank you for helping me put everything away like this, Ms. Otori...

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line: I really appreciate it since there was just so much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Not a problem!
I have a much better understanding of what general affairs involves now!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll be more than happy to lend a hand if you need help with anything else!

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line:
Oh... Hehe.
You're even more energetic than usual.

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line:
But you can clock out for the day.
I'll see you again tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thank you! See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Management Staff Member
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you again.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (General affairs deals with so many different things.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I guess every company is different, but you have to help set up meetings, keep track of all the equipment in the building and all sorts of other stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Alright, I'll read over my notes again after I get home!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I wonder how Suzu learned about management...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I should ask her the next time I see her.)
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't remember coming this way...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: U-Uhhh?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which way did I come from?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What do I do...?!
I think I went the wrong way while I was thinking about everything I've been learning...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Uhhhh... How about this way?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Huh? That looks like...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you again for making the time to meet with me.

rows.Speaker: Board Member
rows.Line: Ah, not a problem. Still...

rows.Speaker: Board Member
rows.Line: It is unfortunate to hear that Kikyogumi is going to be disbanded.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (What...?)

rows.Speaker: Board Member
rows.Line:
Try not to worry too much.
These sorts of decisions are sometimes necessary to ensure the longevity of a company.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Board Member
rows.Line: Please let us know if you'd like to speak with me again. For now, you'll need to excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Of course.
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: These decisions are sometimes necessary...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Kikyogumi is being disbanded...?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Wh-Wh-Wh-What's going on here?!
We just saw them perform the other day...)
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Suzu...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Otori? What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Umm... I got lost after helping put away a few things.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And then just now, I...! Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Let's find a place where we can talk, shall we...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: No one is scheduled to use this rehearsal room right now.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Anyway, Otori, about what you just heard...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really sorry!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I didn't mean to eavesdrop or anything...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But is it true? Kikyogumi is really being disbanded?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes. The board reached a consensus yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
But things haven't been fully finalized yet.
So, please refrain from telling anyone else.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But why...?
Kikyogumi's shows are so amazing...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Ah, that's right. You've seen them perform...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Then, did anything stand out to you?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Stand out?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Yes, for example... The number of empty seats.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It was such a great show, so I did wonder why there were all those empty seats.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: In order to give a proper explanation, I'll probably need to start with how the Kikyogumi troupe initially came to be...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Which may take a while. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, please go on!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The Morinomiya Revue and Suzurangumi were simultaneously established a hundred years ago.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: This company has spent decades establishing the Morinomiya brand of shows. As such, its fan base has become rock solid.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it's also grown stagnant.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, so... They have a lot of fans coming to see their shows, but not many new ones...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Exactly.
Nothing serious has happened yet, but we'll slowly but surely keep fading from the public eye if we let things go on like this.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Kikyogumi was established two years ago with the precise intent of getting ahead of this issue.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The goal was essentially to bring in a new set of fans and breathe new life into Morinomiya by forming an all-male troupe.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However, Kikyogumi is still a very new troupe that's full of young members.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Compared to Suzurangumi, they're lacking in terms of quality... Showgoers have seen reviews of that nature going around, and as a result, the troupe is struggling to bring in the expected earnings.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If a product fails to hit sales targets, then the company must cease producing it.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: And what's more...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: All of Kikyogumi's leads and star-level talent just keep leaving for greener pastures.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Wh-Why...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Wouldn't you want to leave if you were in their shoes?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You push yourself to the absolute limit during practice, but it doesn't fill the seats. On top of that, you're seen as lesser than Suzurangumi. I honestly don't blame them for wanting to leave.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Improving the brand while short-staffed is impossibly difficult. As such, there's no reason to expect an increase in earnings. In other words, the board was right to disband them.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I understand their reasoning. But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Suzu, it sounds like...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You don't want to give up on them, do you?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
No, I don't...
Because I believe they're a vital part of Morinomiya.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: The younger fans find a slight lack of refinement actually charming. When it comes to reaching a new audience, this troupe has been able to produce results.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Plus, the remaining troupe members and the male students are all very passionate about what they do.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Which is why I want to see if we can keep them somehow...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (It's always hard when you can't reach your goal or protect the things you care about...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (That reminds me of Phoenix Wonderland not too long ago.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Suzu!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Can I help you save them?!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I really understand why you want to help Kikyogumi not get disbanded...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I mean, they put on these amazing performances that feel totally different from the ones Suzurangumi does...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There were empty seats, but the people who did come to see them all seemed to really enjoy themselves!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, sorry...! I'm an outsider, so I probably shouldn't be saying all this...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The thing is, Phoenix Wonderland went through something similar a little while back.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We started losing guests...
We tried doing a lot of new things, but nothing worked at first.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, I'm studying management and how to run an organization right now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I want to help you in any way I can, Suzu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Please, let me help you...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Otori...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: It is nice knowing that I have an ally...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Thank you. I'm looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
...!
Me too!
